components.title: Exact catalogue and runtime qualification gate
components.summary: Binds the final 1ec00cf catalogue identity and admits configured Count 1, 2, or 4 only after exact pins, a ready probe, and a sufficient native limit.

flows.title: Default-off configuration to qualified catalogue identity

steps.description: Start with empty identity pins and qualification Count 0.
Require the exact 1ec00cf hash, additional version, and wire identity for nonzero qualification.
Refuse disabled or invalid counts, missing pins, an unready probe, insufficient native limit, or mismatched identity.
Construct and compare the exact canonical catalogue value before marking ready.

facts.statement: The runtime constants bind canonical catalogue value barc-factory-atomic-v1|1ec00cf|BARC-01.5-fr5-peer-observer-v1 Headless|424152432d4652312d5245434f494c2d41544f4d49432d56312d303737463942.

Product configuration defaults to empty pins and Count 0. Runtime readiness accepts only Count 1, 2, or 4 with exact identity pins, a ready capability probe, and native limit at least the configured count; the public effective count defaults to 1 when not ready.

The accepted custody report identifies successor 41aa305ce3722c6b4345ab227ff559d7e9daf31b, tree 9f24ece38d32d4cd5fb012ccfb4ebc199d11304b, as retaining the 13-commit exact 1ec source reconstruction, observer schema acknowledgment barc.fr5.peer-observation/1, eight proto inputs, and 32 generated outputs. This custody successor is provenance for the registered 30fc product source, not a promoted current pointer.

Build6 reports all five focused adapter CTests passed against the coherent source set. This does not admit an installed plugin or engine artifact and does not establish any native Count 1, 2, or 4 observation.
